# Lab 5.10: Restrict Third-party OAuth App Access

## What We Are Going to Do
Control which third-party apps can access Google Cloud data, by blocking unconfigured apps and trusting only the ones you approve.

## Steps

1. **Open API controls.** In the Admin console go to **Security → Access and data control → API controls**.

2. **Review accessed apps.** Click **Manage Third-Party App Access**. You see apps users have already signed in to, and which scopes they use.

3. **Restrict Google Cloud Platform data.** Under **Google services**, find **Google Cloud Platform**. Click it, choose **Restricted**, and save. Now only trusted apps can request Google Cloud scopes.

4. **Trust one app.** Back on **Manage Third-Party App Access**, click **Configure new app**. Search for **Google Cloud SDK**, select it, set access to **Trusted** for all users, and save.

5. **Block unconfigured apps.** In **Settings**, set **Unconfigured third-party apps** to **Don't allow users to access any third-party apps**. Save.

6. **Test it.** As a non-admin user, try to sign in to any third-party app that asks for Google Cloud access. Google shows that access is blocked by the administrator.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Google Cloud Platform service | Restricted |
| Google Cloud SDK | Trusted, so gcloud still works |
| Unconfigured apps | Blocked |
| Audit | Token events in **Reporting → OAuth log events** |
